app.name: FamilyBridge
app.tagline: A companion to your DBT skills group

shell.pausedBody: Take all the time you need. Nothing is lost, and there is no timer.

placeholder.title: Welcome to FamilyBridge
placeholder.subtitle: This is a development build with demo data only.
placeholder.body: Sign-in arrives in the next build phase. You can switch the language and try the accessibility settings here.
placeholder.notMonitored: FamilyBridge is not monitored in real time.
placeholder.comingLater: This area is built in a later phase.

settings.title: Display and comfort
settings.subtitle: These settings only change how things look and sound for you.
settings.reduceMotionHint: Turns off animations. Follows your device setting until you change it.
settings.soundHint: Off unless you turn it on.

gallery.title: Component gallery
gallery.subtitle: Every base component in both languages, both palettes and both densities. Development builds only.

demo.heroBody: Your next suggested activity is ready whenever you are.

auth.haveReset: I have a password reset code
auth.forgotHint: Forgot your password? Ask your therapist for a reset code.
auth.codeHint: 16 letters and numbers, as given to you. Dashes and spaces are optional.
auth.redeemIntro: Enter the invitation code your therapist gave you.
auth.inviteFor: This invitation is for a {{role}} account.
auth.usernameHint: 3–32 characters: lowercase letters, numbers, dot, dash or underscore. Please don't use your real name.
auth.aliasHint: What others in the app will see. A nickname is fine.
auth.passwordHint: At least 10 characters. A few unrelated words work well.
auth.resetIntro: Enter the reset code your therapist or administrator gave you.
auth.resetDone: Your password has been changed. You have been signed out on every device. Please sign in again.

apiErrors.unknown: Something went wrong. Please try again.
apiErrors.network: We couldn't reach FamilyBridge. Check your connection and try again.
apiErrors.validation: Some details are missing or not valid.

auth.invalid_credentials: That username and password don't match.
auth.too_many_attempts: Too many attempts. Please wait about {{minutes}} minute(s) and try again.
auth.csrf_failed: Your session needs refreshing. Please reload the page.

access.forbidden: You don't have access to this.

code.invalid: This code can't be used. It may have expired or been used already. Ask your therapist for a new one.

username.invalid: Usernames are 3–32 characters: lowercase letters, numbers, dot, dash or underscore.
username.taken: That username is already taken. Please choose another.

password.too_long: It can be at most 128 characters.
password.too_common: It is too easy to guess.
password.contains_username: It must not contain your username.
password.current_wrong: Your current password is not right.

family.adolescent_exists: This family already has a teen account or a pending teen invitation.

consent.required_declined: Onboarding can't be completed without the required items.
consent.version_changed: The consent text has been updated. Please reload and read it again.
consent.required_contact_therapist: To change this, please talk to your therapist.
consent.missing: The consent text is not available.

onboarding.participants_only: Onboarding is for teens and caregivers.

group.unknown_therapist: One of the selected therapists can't be found.

suitability.wrong_roles: Choose one teen and one caregiver.

site.contact_label_both_languages: Each contact needs a name in both Chinese and English.
site.missing: Site settings have not been created yet.

lesson.open_exists: You already have a lesson in progress. Continue it or close it first.
lesson.state_changed: That step was already done. The page has been refreshed.
lesson.busy: The coach is still replying. Please wait a moment.
lesson.profile_required: Please fill in your profile first.
lesson.message_too_long: That's a bit long. Please shorten it.
lesson.not_recommended: Please pick the suggested skill or one of the options.
lesson.not_an_alternative: Please pick a skill from the list.
lesson.skill_not_in_record: That skill isn't in this group session's record.
lesson.no_more_attempts: You've already had two tries at this one.
lesson.turn_failed: The reply couldn't be completed. Please try again.

test.not_found: We couldn't find that quick check.
test.lesson_not_completed: The quick check opens after you finish the lesson.
test.out_of_order: Please answer the questions in order.
test.closed: This quick check has already ended.
test.not_completed: Please finish the quick check first.

group_review.not_found: We couldn't find that group session.
group_review.unknown_skill: One of the skills isn't in the skill list.
group_review.therapist_only: Only therapists can change group session records.

diary.unknown_field: That item is not on this card.
diary.invalid_value: One of the answers isn't valid. Please check it.
diary.empty: Fill in at least one item or a note.
diary.note_too_long: The note is too long (1000 characters at most).
diary.date_out_of_range: Entries can be added for today and the previous 6 days.
diary.read_only: Entries older than 7 days can't be changed.
diary.changed_elsewhere: This entry was changed in another window. Reload to see the latest version.
diary.not_participant: Only participants have a Diary Card.
diary.share_not_allowed: Sharing from this card isn't available.
diary.no_fields: Choose at least one item to share.
diary.no_template: The Diary Card isn't available right now.
diary.invalid_range: Choose one of the periods shown.
diary.unknown_homework: That homework is not open for this day.

task.invalid_window: Check the dates: “until” must be on or after “from”, within about two months.
task.invalid_roles: Choose who the homework is for.
task.unknown_skill: One of the linked skills is not recognised.
task.archived: This homework was removed from lists and can no longer be edited.

joint.not_suitable: This pair is not marked suitable for joint work.
joint.episode_not_approved: This episode version can't be assigned to this family.
joint.invalid_window: Check the dates: the window must end after it opens, in the future, within 14 days.
joint.not_in_family: That person is not in this family.
joint.no_adolescent: This family has no adolescent account yet.
joint.not_cancellable: This session can no longer be withdrawn.
joint.window_closed: This session's time window is closed.
joint.not_accepted: The session opens once both of you have said yes.

episode.not_approver: Only content approvers can do this.
episode.invalid_transition: That change isn't possible for this version.

room.no_hint: No more hints for this step.
room.reset_demo_only: Reset is only for demo families.

recruitment.invalid_period: The period must end on or after its start date.
recruitment.funnel_order: Each number must be no larger than the one before it (screened ≥ eligible ≥ approached ≥ consented).

apiErrors.forbidden: You don't have access to this.

codes.shownOnce: Write this code down now. It is shown only once.
codes.handOver: Give it to the person in private. It can only be used once.

help.placeholder: These contacts are placeholders until the hospital confirms them.
help.emergency: If you are in danger right now, call emergency services or go to the nearest emergency department. FamilyBridge is not monitored in real time.

onboarding.title: Welcome, {{alias}}
onboarding.intro: Before you start, please read how FamilyBridge works and who can see what. This takes a few minutes. Your family members do this separately.
onboarding.draftNotice: Draft text for the demo. It has not yet been reviewed by the clinical team.
onboarding.declined: That's okay. FamilyBridge can only be used once the required items are agreed. Please talk to your therapist about any questions; nothing has been recorded.

visibility.subtitle: This list comes from your account's actual settings.
visibility.listTitle: People and services that can see your data
visibility.changeHint: To change who can see your records, talk to your therapist. The research choice can be changed in settings.

sees.only_what_you_share: Only what you choose to share
sees.account_only: Account details only (name in app, status), not your records
sees.pseudonymous_lesson_text: Lesson and practice text, under a code name

account.languageSaved: Language, display and comfort settings are saved to your account automatically.
account.passwordChanged: Password changed. Other devices have been signed out.
account.researchLabel: Include my pseudonymous data in research exports
account.researchHint: No names are included. Turning this off does not change how you can use FamilyBridge.
account.requiredConsentHint: The other consent items are needed to use FamilyBridge. To discuss them, talk to your therapist.
account.logoutAllHint: Sign out on every device, including this one.

admin.therapistsSubtitle: Create therapist accounts with a one-time code.
admin.newTherapistCode: Code for a new therapist account:
admin.siteSubtitle: Help contacts and service hours shown to participants.
admin.placeholderNotice: Use placeholder contacts only until the hospital confirms the real ones (open item O4).

export.subtitle: Download pseudonymous research data as CSV files in a zip.

rules.pseudonymous: People appear only by pseudonym code. No names, usernames, family labels or anything participants typed.
rules.separate: Adolescent and caregiver data are in separate folders. Group, family and session tables are in shared/.
rules.consent: A participant's records are included only if they were made while their research-export consent was on.
rules.dates: Dates only, with a study day (day 1 = account creation). No times of day.
rules.dictionary: Every column is described in data_dictionary.csv inside the zip.
rules.audited: Each download is recorded in the audit log with its row counts.

export.done: Export downloaded. The download was recorded in the audit log.

therapist.noGroups: No groups yet. Create one below.
therapist.familyLabelHint: Use a pseudonymous label, not a surname.
therapist.familySubtitle: Members, invitations and suitability for joint work.
therapist.oneAdolescent: A family has one teen account; this family already has one or has a pending code.
therapist.relationshipHint: For example: mother, grandfather. Stored encrypted.
therapist.suitabilityHint: A clinical decision for each teen–caregiver pair. Joint activities stay closed unless marked suitable.
therapist.noteHint: Visible to therapists only. Stored encrypted.

skillRecords.title: Skills covered in group sessions
skillRecords.hint: Members see these skills under Group review (not your note). Reviewing is optional.
skillRecords.noteHint: Optional. Do not include participants' real names.

diary.noFamilies: No families in this group yet.
diary.subtitle: Each person's card is shown separately. Opening this page is recorded.
diary.noMembers: No participants in this family yet.
diary.daysWithExpected: days with an entry (of {{n}}; about {{expected}} expected at {{perWeek}} a week)

schedule.subtitle: Diary expectations and group homework. Lessons are never assigned.
schedule.diaryHint: How many days a week participants are asked to fill in their Diary Card. Missed days are never shown to them as missed.
schedule.taskDetailsHint: Participants see this text. Keep it short and supportive.

progress.subtitle: Which skills each person has practised. Nobody is compared with anyone else.
progress.coverageHint: Each cell shows lessons finished for that skill. Shades show how many, not how well.

learning.title: Learning review
learning.subtitle: Summaries only. Participants' own words open on request, and each opening is recorded.
learning.auditNote: Opening this is recorded in the audit log.

content.subtitle: Cached AI teaching items served to caregivers. Any therapist may review them; each decision is recorded.
content.meta: {{language}} · {{variant}} · prompt v{{prompt}} · knowledge base v{{kb}} · served {{hits}} times · {{date}}
content.withdrawn: Withdrawn. It is no longer served; a new version will appear here for review.
content.cacheTitle: Cached AI explanations, practice items and quizzes
content.episodesHint: Approve a draft version so it can be assigned to any family, or retire a version. Demo versions stay demo-only.
content.episodesNotApprover: Only content approvers can approve or retire versions. Demo versions can be assigned to demo families.

metrics.subtitle: Feasibility indicators for your group. Counts only; nobody is compared.

joint.subtitle: Schedule joint activities for suitable pairs and follow their progress. The board updates every few seconds and shows step progress only.
joint.scheduleHint: Only pairs you marked suitable, and episode versions that are approved (or demo versions for demo families).
joint.noSuitable: No pair in this family is marked suitable. Set suitability on the family page first.
joint.noEpisodes: No episode version can be assigned to this family yet.

pauseBy.safety: needs you to resume or end

joint.comingSoonHint: Planned worlds and levels. Content arrives with the final scripts.
joint.summarySubtitle: Rubric-coded outputs, attendance, check-ins and reflections. Partners never see this.
joint.audited: Opening this summary is recorded in the audit log.

recruitment.title: Recruitment numbers
recruitment.hint: Counts of families for a period, used as denominators in the research export. Saving the same period again replaces its figures.

safety.helpSubtitle: How to reach real people if things feel hard
safety.draftNotice: This help text is a draft. The hospital team has not reviewed it yet.
safety.queueSubtitle: Safety events for families in your groups
safety.queueNotice: Events appear only here. Nobody is sent a text, call or email, so check this queue during your working hours.
safety.oversightNotice: Read-only oversight. Therapists handle events; opening one is recorded in the audit log.
safety.readOnlyNotice: Read-only oversight view. Opening this event was recorded in the audit log.
safety.descriptionHint: Facts only. Use the code names shown in the app, not real names.
safety.excerptPrivacy: Private to the clinical team. Never share it with other family members.

noExcerpt.urge: No text: a Diary Card urge rating reached the threshold.

safety.followUpHint: Needed to resolve: what was done or arranged.
safety.noteHint: Notes cannot be edited or deleted later.
safety.manualHint: For concerns raised outside the app, for example in a group session.
safety.noSubjects: There are no participants in your groups yet.
safety.subject: Participant

kb.subtitle: Status of the manual's search index. Read-only; ingestion runs from the command line.
kb.notice: The index holds the manual's text for grounding AI answers. No manual text is shown here, and participants only ever see original wording.
kb.empty: The knowledge base is empty. Run `python -m app.cli kb ingest` on the server.
kb.searches: Searches in the last {{days}} days ({{insufficient}} without a close match)
kb.evalTarget: Target: the right handout in the top {{k}} for at least {{target}} of queries, in each language.
kb.noEval: No evaluation recorded for this version. Run `python -m app.cli kb eval --record`.
kb.noMismatches: Every page header matches the handout index.
kb.mismatchHint: These pages print a different handout number from the index. The index is used; this is expected for the known misprints.

aiAdmin.subtitle: How the AI layer is doing. Read-only; evaluations run from the command line.
aiAdmin.notice: Counts and codes only. No participant text and no AI output is shown here. Every AI answer is checked by fixed rules, and an authored fallback is used when a check fails.
aiAdmin.calls: AI calls in the last {{days}} days
aiAdmin.noCalls: No AI calls in this period.
aiAdmin.noFailures: No rejected answers in this period.
aiAdmin.noEval: No evaluation has been run yet. Run `python -m app.cli ai eval` on the server.
aiAdmin.promptsHint: {{count}} prompts in use (latest version of each); {{fallbacks}} fallback files.

learn.subtitle: One-to-one skills practice, at your own pace

mood.before: Before we start, how are you feeling right now?
mood.after: Now that we're done, how are you feeling?
mood.afterTest: How are you feeling after the quick check?
mood.noteHint: You can leave this empty. Only you and your therapist can see it.

closed.completed: This is a lesson you finished on {{date}}.
closed.user_terminated: This lesson ended on {{date}}. You can start a new one any time.
closed.stopped_by_safety: This lesson was paused on {{date}}. If you need it, support is in Help.

profileFirst.title: First, tell us a little about you
profileFirst.body: Only age and grade are needed; everything else is optional. It helps practice fit your life.

start.title: Start a skills lesson
start.body: Note how you feel, then we'll pick a skill that fits today. You can pause or stop at any time.

open.title: You have a lesson in progress
open.body: You can pick up where you left off, or close it.
open.bodySkill: “{{skill}}” is still open. You can pick up where you left off, or close it.
open.hint: Closing it has no downside; you can start a new one any time.

checkin.hint: You can skip this. What you write is only used for this lesson, and only you and your therapist can see it.
checkin.pickForMe: Just pick a skill for me

lesson.title: Skills lesson
lesson.working: One moment, getting the next step ready…

test.title: Quick check
test.intro: Want to see how it's sinking in? Five short scenarios; try as many times as you like.
test.question: Question {{n}} of {{total}}
test.unavailable: We couldn't get the questions ready right now. You can try again later.

outcomeBody.got_it: You know this skill well. Come back any time if you'd like more practice.
outcomeBody.another_look: This skill is worth another look. Want to try again?

progress.title: Skills you've practised
progress.empty: Skills you practise will show up here.

group.subtitle: Skills from your group
group.optional: Reviewing is entirely optional: no deadlines and no reminders.
group.empty: Skills from your group sessions will appear here once your therapist adds them.

explore.subtitle: Browse DBT skills by module and learn at your own pace
explore.title: Choose a skill

home.bodyTeen: Practise when you feel like it. No pressure when you don't.
home.bodyCarer: Learn DBT skills a little at a time, at your own pace.

profile.subtitle: Helps practice fit your life. Only you and your therapist can see it.
profile.privacy: Your parents or carers can't see any of this.

cg.practiceHint: These are made-up, everyday scenes; there's no need to write about your own life. You get two tries at each.
cg.noPersonal: A sentence or two is plenty; no real people or events needed.
cg.tryAgainHint: You can try once more if you like.
cg.reflection: Where might this skill be useful this week? (optional, private)
cg.reflectionHint: No need to mention anyone or anything specific; you can leave it empty.

diary.missedOkay: Missed entries are okay — add one when you can.
diary.empty: No entries in the last 30 days.
diary.skipAnything: Answer what feels right. You can skip any item.
diary.readOnly: Entries older than 7 days can be read but not changed.

sharedWithMe.title: Shared with me
sharedWithMe.empty: Nothing has been shared with you.

share.title: Share with a family member
share.intro: Choose what to share from this entry. Nothing else is shared, and you can stop sharing at any time.
share.noRecipients: There is no one in your family you can share with yet.
share.snapshot: They will see this entry as it is now. Later changes are not shared.

homework.title: Homework
homework.hint: Tick anything from your group's homework that you did.

homework.title: This week's homework
homework.hint: From your group. Tick it in your Diary Card when you have done it.
homework.tickInDiary: Open your Diary Card to tick homework

joint.subtitle: Activities for you and your family member, set up by your therapist.
joint.optional: Joint activities are always optional. You can say no, pause or stop at any time, and you never need to give a reason.
joint.canStop: You can say no, or stop at any time. No reason needed.

status.wont_run: This session won't run this time

solo.title: Practise on your own
solo.hint: Try a short placeholder activity by yourself. Nothing is shared with your family member.

room.subtitle: Take your time. There is no time limit.
room.tryAgain: That didn't go through. Please try again.
room.cannotJoin: This session can't be opened right now.
room.ended: This session has ended for now.
room.endedBody: That's okay. You can talk with your therapist about another time.
room.partnerAway: Your family member's connection dropped. Their place is saved.
room.waitingPartner: Waiting for your family member. There is no time limit.
room.held: The session is paused for now
room.heldBody: Your therapist will pick it up from here. Nothing you did is lost.
room.pausedBody: Either of you can carry on when you're ready. Nothing is lost.
room.pausedSolo: Carry on when you're ready. Nothing is lost.
room.leaveConfirm: Leave? The session ends for both of you.
room.bothDone: You're both done with this step.
room.waitingNext: Waiting for your family member to continue.
room.waitingChoice: Waiting for your family member to choose.
room.distress: How tense do you feel? (0 to 10)
room.distressPrivate: Only you and your therapist can see this.
room.choicePrivate: Your family member can't see your choice yet.
room.reflectionPrivate: Only you and your therapist can see this.
room.reflectionSaved: Saved. Only you and your therapist can see it.
